title: Zuiderzee Campsites

services.name: Zuiderzee Campsites
services.desc: Tucked away just 20 minutes south of Nanaimo BC, Zuiderzee Campsites offers a peaceful lakeside escape where nature, family tradition, and outdoor adventure comes together. Set on 28.5 beautiful acres along the shores of Quennell Lake, our campground has been family owned since 1959 - welcoming generations of guests who return year after year. Whether you're casting a line into waters known for exceptional bass and trout fishing, enjoying a refreshing swim on a warm summer day, or gathering around a crackling fire under the stars , Zuiderzee provides the perfect backdrop to slow down and reconnect. Guests have access to washrooms and hot showers, a convenient boat launch or row boat rentals
